responsibility: Implements the concrete RTL patterns and assembly mappings for the C-SKY FPv2 floating-point instruction set. It covers FPv2-specific abs/neg/sqrt/add/sub/mul/div operations, comparisons and condition-code setting for SF and DF, numeric conversions between integer and floating types, and move patterns that coordinate general and vector/FPU registers, thereby supplying the exact instruction forms selected by the generic floating-point expanders when FPv2 features are enabled.
